messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Increased warmup failures and paging in us-west-2 cluster. Error rate spike 16% for model load/warmup. Autoscaler reports paging events and OOMs during deserialization. Investigating.
oncall-maria: Ack. I'm oncall — looking into hot paths now. Any customer-facing errors yet? :eyes:
support-sam: Seeing a handful of 502s and elevated latency for a small group of customers on the dedicated tier (ids: cust-842, cust-199). Support is triaging, but they're seeing timeouts around model init.
eng-josh: Copy. Attaching a recent warmup log from a failing pod:
```
2026-03-15T21:12:41Z model-warmup: starting
loading artifact shard 12/24
deserialize: zstd -> mmap
ERROR: OOM when allocating tensor (size=2.1G)
Caused by: cudaErrorMemoryAllocation: out of memory
stack: runtime/loader.cc:412
```
eng-josh: Looks like deserialization pushes working set past GPU mem and triggers host <-> GPU paging, then container OOMs. We're seeing a compile timeout cascade on top of that for a few models.
sre-lee: Node metrics show heavy swap activity around the same window, some containers thrashing. Host OOM killer hasn't reclaimed because most memory pinned on GPU-backed mmap.
oncall-maria: First mitigation: move load traffic off the failing pool. @eng-josh can you run route policy to fallback model-variant for affected model_id=rlm-large-v3?
eng-josh: On it. Command I used:
```
redwood-cli route update --model rlm-large-v3 --fallback rlm-large-v3-8bit --region us-west-2 --dry-run=false
```
eng-josh: Done. Traffic gradually shifting to 8-bit variant. Will monitor for errors.
sre-lee: I'm scaling up warmup-capacity with extra cold nodes to absorb stampede: adding 6 nodes to us-west-2 pool.
```
infra> aws autoscale set-desired-capacity --auto-scaling-group warmup-usw2 --desired-capacity 18
```
support-sam: Noted. I'll update affected customers with ETA ~15-30m for stabilization, and mention fallback to 8-bit variant (possible mild quality regression).
product-ana: Heads-up: one enterprise customer reported degraded completion quality. We should include that in incident comms and track any regressions tied to quantized fallback.
oncall-maria: We're also going to temporarily disable concurrent-prefetch for warmup on the pool to reduce memory pressure. @eng-josh can you deploy that setting?
eng-josh: Pushing config change:
```
PATCH /api/v1/pools/us-west-2/warmup
{ "concurrent_prefetch": 1 }
```
eng-josh: Change applied. Warmup attempts now serializing deserializations to avoid memory overlap. Early telemetry: deserial OOMs down 60% in the last 3m.
sre-lee: Found one node with repeated container restarts — collecting kube describe and pod logs. Suspect corrupted artifact causing reallocation loop.
```
kubectl -n runtime describe pod runtime-load-xyz
kubectl -n runtime logs runtime-load-xyz -c loader
```
sre-lee: Artifact shard 12 checksum mismatch on disk; eviction and re-pull in progress. Evicting shard from node and restarting loader container for that pod.
eng-josh: For safety, adding a compile-time timeout override to avoid long compile stalls holding GPU memory:
```
redwood-config set compile.timeout_ms=45000 --scope=warmup
```
oncall-maria: Good. We'll also enable model fallback policy to route new requests to smaller variant if warmup fails twice within 30s.
support-sam: Customers updated. One asked for a postmortem and timeline — I've captured initial impact window and steps.
product-ana: Please track quality delta for the impacted customers. If fallback causes unacceptable regressions, we'll plan a rapid rollback to a different variant or route through dedicated-hosted.
eng-josh: Current status: deserial OOM rate ~4% (was 16%), compile timeouts reduced, node restarts decreased. Fallback routing handled 12% of traffic for the model.
oncall-maria: Handing off to oncall rotation at 03:00 UTC. @sre-lee you're primary for node evictions, @eng-josh you'll own model config rollbacks. Leave any remaining tasks here.
sre-lee: Acknowledged. I'll keep watch on paging metrics and confirm the corrupt artifact re-pull success. :thumbsup:
eng-josh: Acknowledged; I'll leave the compile timeout and concurrent_prefetch changes in place for now. Will revert after stability window 1h if no regressions.
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigation applied (fallback routing + reduced concurrent_prefetch + compile timeout). Customer impact reduced. Open actions: artifact integrity scan across pool, longer-term: streaming deserialization to reduce peak mem. Next update in 30m or on escalation.
support-sam: Adding follow-up ticket to CS/Prod for comms and postmortem request.
product-ana: Adding a quality-monitoring eval against the fallback for the affected customers to track any regression.
oncall-maria: Leaving notes and handoff completed. If error rate climbs back above 8% reopen channel. :handshake:
support-sam: Thanks team. I'll close the immediate customer escalations once we have 60m of stable metrics.
